description: Our Molecule Scent 01 contains a proprietary mixture of Iso E Super, that focuses on gamma isomers, which results in increased allure. Almost pheromonic Unisex Please note that Iso E Super is a very subtle fragrance that cannot be detected by everyone, make sure you know about Iso E Super prior to purchase Iso E Super is an aroma-chemical, which, on its own, is less of a fragrance than an effect. Almost transparent in colour it has a vague sweet cedarwood-like scent imparting a male, woodsy, musky type aroma. It is known as the invisible fragrance, and has also been likened to a modern day Love Potion No.9! The reason for this is that it has been known to mimic the action of human pheromones. Although not a pheromone itself, it has the effect of other people noticing you or your fragrance but not quite being able to put their finger on the reason why. This is because ordinary fragrances are designed to project themselves over a wide radius, whilst Iso E Super is designed to cling to the skin, swapping itself between opulence and simplicity, sometimes being quite noticeable, sometimes undetectable. The wearer may notice a subtle, velvety, woody note which will vanish, then re-surface after some time. More than this, she or he will notice the impact the fragrance has on other people, because Iso E Super lends an indefinable allure to the wearer. In fact, its effect is almost pheromonic.

description: Salicylic acid, a Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) is oil-soluble which makes it ideal for the acne-prone. It reduces oiliness and pore build-up since it is able to penetrate through the oil unlike its AHA counterpart. This aids in reducing sebaceous follicle blockage to help reduce the occurrence of future breakouts. Glycolic acid is an AHA that is best for improving texture and reducing the appearance of lines. Derived from sugar cane, glycolic acid’s anti-aging benefits come from its small molecular size that can deeply penetrate the skin. It’s useful for a host of skin conditions from pigmentation issues, uneven texture, acne scarring, and wrinkles and fine lines. Mandelic acid helps treat a wide range of issues from acne, scarring, fine lines and wrinkles. Because it has a larger molecular size compared to other AHAs, it is able to gently exfoliate the skin with less chance of post-peel inflammation or hyperpigmentation. Azelaic acid is naturally found in grains like rye, wheat, and barley. It is a dicarboxylic acid and is especially good at evening out pigmentation and improving skin tone. It blocks keratin production which can help lessen the occurence of clogged pores and help reduce breakouts. Tea tree oil has been proven effective in reducing acne bacteria and is a natural alternative to benzoyl peroxide. It is an essential oil extracted from the leaves of the Melaleuca Alternifolia tree native to Australia.

title: RazoRock MJ-90 Double Edge Safety Razor - CNC Machined
description: Handle Material: 316L Stainless Steel Polish Finish Head Material: 6061 Billet Aluminum, Anodize Black Finish Thread: M5 x .8 Handle Length: 90 mm - Handle Diameter: 13 mm Handle Weight: 3.1 oz What is the MJ-90? We took the ever popular DE89 razor head, studied it, analyzed all it's positive and negative qualities and made it WAY better! What did we do and why is it better? 1) Materials: Instead of low-quality zinc-alloy (Zamak/pot metal), we used aircraft aluminum block for the head and 316L stainless steel rod for the handle. 2) Build: Instead of cheap, non-precise stamping/casting, we have built the razor using precision CNC milling, both for the head and handle. The tolerances are superior to the DE89. 3) Design: Instead of having the blade tabs exposed, we have milled the tolerances of the guideposts to precisely hold the blade with very little blade play, meaning the blade tabs can be covered, protecting your precious ear lobes :) 4) Longevity: The DE89 is well known for its threaded post snapping off. Why? Because it uses cheap pot metal and because it's post is spot welded on. Drop it from 12-18 inches and the post breaks off into the handle rendering your $40-45 razor useless and ready for the landfill. We completely milled the top cap from a block of aircraft aluminum, meaning the top cap is one solid piece, no broken posts here! 5) Handle: Instead of using a hollow cheap handle, we have milled our handle from solid 316L marine-grade stainless steel and hand polished it. We have also milled in our RazoRock Halo rings for extreme grip and comfort! 6) Price: Even though we made all the necessary improvements above, it sells for only $39.99! How does this even make sense when the competition is selling a far inferior product for $35-60? I'll leave that with you to ponder :) With the RazoRock brand, our goal is to make things better and less expensive.
